# Mailtrap Email Integration

Curated by Skill Harbor: patterns for adding transactional email to an application with Mailtrap's Email API. It covers the core discipline (sandbox vs. production separation so test emails never reach real inboxes), Bearer-token authentication scoped per project, domain verification via SPF, DKIM, and DMARC before production sending, TypeScript code examples for both endpoints, and an anti-pattern table (production endpoint in dev, hardcoded tokens, unverified domains, missing retry handling) with the fix for each. Pure Markdown skill, no code runs on install. By @affaan-m, listed here with credit to its creator. From the affaan-m/ECC repository (MIT). Honest caveats: requires a Mailtrap account and API token; production sending needs a verified sending domain. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use.
